LESSON: REPAIRING GARMENTS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Lea
Topic 4.1: Repairing garments
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Repairing garments, part of PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Lea in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can we repair garments? 2. Why is it important to repair garments?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Repairing garments together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: The learner takes care of their clothes by maintaining them in good conditions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
●Financial literacy: The learner saves costs of repairs.

● Life skills: The learner adopts the stitches to repair their daily wear.

Link to other subjects:

Creative arts: The learners apply the same skills learnt in creative arts to do stitching while repairing garments.

Suggested learning resources:

• Needles and thread

• Sample garments with backstitches and running stitches,

• Print and no print media

• Digital devices.
